title: New! Welcome to Downtown Nashville! Wi-fi | Pool
description:
This is a brand new suite located in the heart of Nashville!
Perfect for all occasions and the whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.
Suite accommodates up to 6 guests.

The suite is just steps from Broadway, the Music City Center, and Nashville’s best honky-tonks.

Enjoy the properties amenities including pool, gym, and sky lounge.

Walkable to dining, nightlife, and top attractions.

20mins from BNA Airport

Parking $25 per night

Permit2018072103

The space
The suite comfortably accommodates 6 guests with two queen size beds and two single fold down couches.

Kitchen is equipped with kitchen essentials.

Smart TV available for your favorite streaming services.

The suite also has a private balcony.

Wifi available

Enjoy the amenities the property has to offer such as pool, gym, and multiple community areas.

Guest access
The entire property is operated with DOOR smart-lock system.

Guests will receive access and check-instructions prior to check-in.

Other things to note
Parking is available upon request for one vehicle.
Parking is $25 per night
If you have additional vehicle(s), you may park the additional vehicle(s) at Guest Parking which is the main garage located next to the property's main entrance. Please note the property charges their own guest parking fees.

Early check-in is available upon request and availability. $50 fee

Late check-out is available upon request and availability. $50 fee

If you arrive early, you may use the property's bellhop service. A fee does apply.
